requirements.text: The system shall maintain a maximum of 5 simultaneous borrow operations for physical books and allow 7 for e-books to promote resource efficiency and responsible borrowing.
The system shall automatically track and notify members of overdue books within 24 hours of the due date to ensure accountability.
The system shall provide a backup mechanism to recover all transaction data in case of a failure.
The system shall log all transactions, including borrow and return actions, for audit purposes.
The system shall implement strong authentication measures to ensure only registered members can access borrowing features.
The system shall ensure compliance with data protection regulations by implementing encryption for all member data.
The system shall provide an accessible interface for all users, including those with disabilities, to promote fairness and inclusivity.
The system shall provide incentives for borrowing e-books to promote sustainable practices.
